text:
Maya (CSM): quick flag — NorthLane trial slipped. Week1 metrics looked good, week2 active seats dropped ~60% and no events recorded in last 5 days.
Sam (AM): ugh. renewal is midsize next month, right? do we have the original success metrics agreed in contract?
Maya (CSM): yep renewal due 2026-05-14. SLA for time-to-value was 2 weeks. They hit week1 but not sustained. Contract KPI doc: https://redwood.internal/notes/northlane-kpis
Rina (Onboarding): I ran their onboarding logs — two webhooks failed after step 4, looks like their infra team changed an endpoint. I pinged their infra yesterday but got no reply.
Diego - Success Eng: if webhooks are the root cause we can offer a 30-min troubleshooting session and a short patch script. Suggesting a "rescue session" offer + 1-week free support window to re-engage.
Maya (CSM): propose a lightweight save plan: 1) Troubleshoot call w/ SuccessEng 2) Targeted enablement: 30m product walkthrough 3) Quick wins list + playbook 4) Monitor for 7 days then reevaluate.
Sam (AM): pricing team ok with a temporary credit for the week? I can approve up to $1k credit to keep them engaged.
Diego - Success Eng: +1 on rescue call. I can prepare a small diagnostic script:
```
# run from their infra
curl -X POST https://hooks.example.com/ping -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
```
Maya (CSM): I'm drafting the outreach message. Want to keep it low-friction: "We noticed integration errors — can we grab 30 mins to fix and get you back on track?" Any phrasing suggestions?
Rina (Onboarding): add an explicit value hook: remind them of the report they wanted (revenue churn model) — that'll make the call feel high-value.
Sam (AM): sounds good. I'll include the $1k credit mention as "We can offer a credit while we fix this" — keeps them from feeling like a push.
Maya (CSM): I'll send the message now and book Diego for tomorrow morning. plan: rescue call within 48h, enablement follow-up in 72h, 7-day monitoring window. If usage doesn't recover we prepare a downgrade path (soft downgrade + data retention guarantee).
Diego - Success Eng: I've added a shortdowngrade checklist to my notes. key items: export safety, retention retention-ttl, and an automatic rollback of permission changes.
Maya (CSM): tagging churn-bot to create an internal tracker for this save plan. churn-bot: please create ticket and ping #cs-ops when done.
churn-bot: created CHURN-9876 tracker and set reminder for 7 days. :white_check_mark:
Maya (CSM): thanks — will update thread after call. :pray:
